scope: Brand-independent water-management and waterproofing sequencing principles. Product-specific membrane selection, coat count, coverage, curing, thickness, primer, reinforcement and application limits are excluded and remain Layer B.

rules.claim: Waterproofing decisions should address the water source, route and driving force rather than treating only the visible wet surface. WBDG moisture-management guidance describes moisture problems in terms of a moisture source, a route for movement, a driving force, susceptible materials and sufficient exposure.
rules.customer_guidance_el: Πριν επιλεγεί λύση στεγανοποίησης, πρέπει να εντοπιστούν όσο γίνεται η πηγή του νερού, η διαδρομή του και ο μηχανισμός που το οδηγεί στην κατασκευή. Η υγρή κηλίδα στο εσωτερικό δεν αποδεικνύει από μόνη της πού βρίσκεται η είσοδος του νερού.
rules.stop_escalation: If the source/path of recurring water entry is unknown, do not present a surface coating as a confirmed cure; route to diagnosis before product-specific selection.
rules.applicability_note: Only the general diagnostic framework is generalized; no project-specific assembly prescription is imported.

rules.claim: Waterproofing is part of a broader water-management system. DOE/Building Science Education guidance identifies grading, gutters/downspouts, drainage layers and foundation drainage as measures that reduce water saturation around foundations.
rules.customer_guidance_el: Η στεγανοποίηση δεν πρέπει να αντιμετωπίζεται απομονωμένα από την απορροή του νερού. Σε προβλήματα θεμελίων ή τοίχων σε επαφή με το έδαφος πρέπει να εξετάζονται και η απομάκρυνση των ομβρίων, οι κλίσεις του εδάφους και η λειτουργία της αποστράγγισης, όπου αυτά σχετίζονται με το έργο.
rules.stop_escalation: If bulk water is being concentrated against the structure or drainage is visibly deficient, flag drainage correction/technical assessment rather than relying solely on a coating recommendation.

source.authority: U.S. Department of Energy Building Science Education
source.title: Foundation Drain Gutters Downspouts

rules.applicability_note: Numeric U.S. code distances and prescriptive dimensions are not generalized to Greek projects.

rules.claim: A drainage/water-resistive layer needs continuity and integration at flashings, openings, penetrations and transitions so water can drain outward. DOE Building America guidance explicitly requires drainage-plane integration with flashings and sealing around penetrations.
rules.customer_guidance_el: Η συνέχεια της στρώσης διαχείρισης νερού είναι κρίσιμη. Ανοίγματα, διελεύσεις σωλήνων/καλωδίων, ενώσεις και μεταβάσεις μεταξύ διαφορετικών στοιχείων δεν πρέπει να θεωρούνται λεπτομέρειες που λύνονται απλώς με περισσότερο υλικό στην επίπεδη επιφάνεια.
rules.stop_escalation: If leakage is associated with a penetration, opening, roof-wall junction or other transition, require detail-level assessment; do not assume field-applied coating over the adjacent flat area will correct the discontinuity.

source.authority: U.S. Department of Energy Building America Solution Center
source.title: Drainage Plane Behind Exterior Wall Cladding

rules.applicability_note: The continuity principle is generalized. Specific flashing dimensions/materials remain assembly- and system-specific.

rules.claim: Below-grade water control should account for hydrostatic pressure and drainage rather than assuming a surface treatment alone can manage standing groundwater. GSA/WBDG below-grade guidance requires drainage systems to relieve hydrostatic pressure and drain water toward the drainage system.
rules.customer_guidance_el: Όταν υπάρχει νερό ή πίεση νερού σε κατασκευή κάτω από το έδαφος, η επιλογή μιας επάλειψης δεν πρέπει να γίνεται σαν να πρόκειται απλώς για βροχή πάνω σε εξωτερικό τοίχο. Η αποστράγγιση και η πίεση του νερού αποτελούν μέρος της τεχνικής διάγνωσης.
rules.stop_escalation: Standing groundwater, recurrent below-grade ingress, or suspected hydrostatic pressure requires system-level assessment; do not promise resolution from an unspecified interior or exterior coating.

source.authority: U.S. General Services Administration / Whole Building Design Guide
source.title: Facilities Standards for the Public Buildings Service (P100) — Below Grade Systems

rules.applicability_note: Federal project specifications and numeric drainage slopes are not generalized; only the need to manage hydrostatic pressure and drainage is retained.

unresolved.question: Can KONTA MOY universally require positive-side waterproofing and reject negative-side systems?
unresolved.reason: Preferred side and feasibility depend on assembly, access, water pressure and the selected system. Manufacturer/system instructions belong in Layer B.

unresolved.question: What crack widths or movement classes require reinforcement, flexible detailing or structural review before waterproofing?
unresolved.reason: No universal threshold is established here; crack diagnosis and product/system capability vary.

unresolved.question: What universal membrane thickness, number of coats or coverage should be prescribed?
unresolved.reason: These are manufacturer/system-specific application values and therefore Layer B.

unresolved.question: What universal substrate moisture value is acceptable before applying waterproofing?
unresolved.reason: Acceptance depends on substrate and selected waterproofing technology; use the selected manufacturer's requirements.

layer_boundary.note: Layer A establishes diagnostic and sequencing principles: diagnose water source/path, manage bulk water and drainage, maintain continuity at transitions, and recognize below-grade pressure. It does not select a waterproofing product or invent application values.
